Class Track

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.gc49.server.model.Track.Track
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class Track extends Object implements Serializable
Manages the turn order and action selection boards for the game.

The track consists of two distinct areas: - The orderBoard, which determines the turn order for choosing an action. - The offerBoard, which holds the chosen actions (offers) and determines the turn order for executing those actions. Players move continuously between these two boards during the core gameplay loop.
